main.name: Yiping Deng
main.description: Passionate penetration tester, open source supporter and crawler export.
main.bio: I am a Computer Science undergraduate student in Jacobs University Bremen. I love to build infrastructure that empowers technology to thrive. In a digital age, the infrastructures are operating system, computer networks, container technologies and etc. Despite the fact that I am a Computer Science student, I also took math major classes in my first year, and I ended up with a even higher score in my math courses and finished a math research project. I believe that most of the Computer Science problem can be solved elegently mathematically, and it is the mathematical structure that makes Computer Science amazing. I also love baking(not only sweets but also LaTeX). I regularly run to keep my mind clear and stay healthy mentally and physically.
